headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 30, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a thrilling 6-5 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Kyle Manzardo leading the charge at the plate. Manzardo's impressive performance included a home run and 4 RBIs, while Franco Aleman shone on the mound with 5 strikeouts in 2 innings of work.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. The Texas Rangers transferred Jose Corniell from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. Danny Jansen was also transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right forearm strain. Additionally, the Boston Red Sox placed Curtis Mead on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 28, 2026, due to a left wrist tracture. Other teams have also made injury-related moves, including the Minnesota Twins, Tampa Bay Rays, Kansas City Royals, and San Francisco Giants.

Several teams have made roster moves, including trades and signings. The Texas Rangers acquired Chase Silseth and Logan O'Hoppe from the Los Angeles Angels in exchange for Angel Arredondo. The Baltimore Orioles traded Johnathan Rodríguez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The San Diego Padres signed SS Nu'u Contrades, while the St. Louis Cardinals traded RHP Scott Blewett to the Athletics for cash.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge Reds in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the Cincinnati Reds, with Kyle Manzardo leading the charge at the plate. Manzardo's impressive performance included a home run and 4 RBIs, while Franco Aleman shone on the mound with 5 strikeouts in 2 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Guardians 2-0**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jose Franco earning the win. In the game, JJ Bleday led the Reds' offense with a home run, his 18th of the season.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Orioles 14-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 14-0 victory. Eduardo Valencia led the Orioles' offense with 4 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Edge Pirates in Thrilling 8-7 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a hard-fought 8-7 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, overcoming a late deficit to take the game. Brandon Lowe led the Diamondbacks' offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 6-8 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a hard-fought win against the Philadelphia Phillies, with multiple players making significant contributions to the team's success. Impact hitters for the Marlins included Trea Turner, Justin Crawford, Otto Lopez, Heriberto Hernández, Esteury Ruiz, and Griffin Conine.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, winning 3-0. Gabriel Moreno, Max Kepler, and Jared Triolo were among the impact hitters in the game.

top_news.title: **Jose Corniell Shifted to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers right-handed pitcher Jose Corniell has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. This change in status is effective as of July 29, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rangers Acquire Chase Silseth in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels traded RHP Chase Silseth and C Logan O'Hoppe to the Texas Rangers in exchange for SS Angel Arredondo. This move adds depth to the Rangers' pitching rotation.
